name: Starter Pack
description: The whole launch catalog in one bundle: all 6 avatars and both personas.
longDescription: Start here. The Starter Pack references every launch listing — Jolly, Tree, Straw Hat Explorer, Neon Founder, Cozy Scholar, Pixel Sprite, Sharp Operator, and Warm Companion — so a new Muse user can install the full set in minutes. The bundle itself ships a manifest (bundle.json); install each referenced slug individually.

safety.notes: Manifest-only bundle. Every referenced listing is individually vetted and checksum-verified on install.
